opening.argument: The video walks viewers through contacting Facebook Ads Support in Hindi, showing a Facebook Ads Help Centre page and explaining how to select email, fill in a support form, and describe an advertising problem. Those steps concern ads support through Facebook business help pages; they do not ask viewers to pay, invest, or provide credentials to an unrelated party. The speaker also notes that an Ads Support option may be available only after a minimum amount has been spent on Facebook ads, rather than presenting access as unconditional. The request to subscribe, like, and share is ordinary audience engagement, not a condition for receiving money or support. Taken together, the visible page and the spoken directions are an instructional walkthrough of an advertising-support process.
